name: Fuentes de Oñoro (Spain)
description: Square flag of five vertical stripes of blue, white, blue, white and blue with a broad white central stripe, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentes de Oñoro (a cross and chalice on red, a lion and a fountain).
history: The arms of Fuentes de Oñoro, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 9 October 1955, recall the feat of the parish priest Luis Silva, who on 3 May 1811 went among the bullets to save the Eucharist kept in a ciborium; the municipal flag was approved on 23 August 1996.
